blockingFindings.description: Direct crouch and seated renders still show the undershorts prominently below the lifted overskirt. Pose-matched overskirt ray coverage remains low: crouch upper thigh L/R 0.3955/0.4068 and sit 0.3525/0.3638; this is geometric coverage evidence only, not fit acceptance.

The 12 radial cut planes and four added height rows are present in the built sewn mesh (10,026 vertices; 19,489 triangles; no degenerate or non-manifold edges), but direct front/back/profile renders still show broad, wrinkled/faceted panel regions instead of controlled, clean pleats. Added topology alone did not yield the needed surface form.

Crouch and sit views show the skirt lifting and folding upward around the exposed shorts; the prone view still reads as a wide uneven fan. The longer hem and denser mesh have not established motion-safe coverage or fabric response.

Direct inspection of all five current views and six pose renders shows a largely plain ivory jacket, broad diagonal lavender panel, and oversized angular elbow patches. Rear and side finish remain sparse and do not read as a finished fencing-practice garment.
Back and profile views remain visually plain, with a broad featureless torso/back and abrupt skirt transition; the surface still lacks a convincing finished rear waist/panel treatment.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
